hint.add: Keeps a copy you can reread any time.
hint.changed: This has changed since you saved it — updating replaces your copy's text.

notify.noGM: Your journal needs the GM online to set it up the first time — ask them.
notify.timeout: The GM's client didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
notify.failed: Couldn't add this to your journal — tell the GM.
notify.tooLarge: This is too large to keep in your journal.

gmButton.name: Show the Add button to the GM
gmButton.hint: For testing the player flow from the GM client. The GM gets a journal like anyone else. Note: the GM can always read every player's journal.

singlePage.name: Eye readables open as a single page
singlePage.hint: When an eye's journal has only one page, players don't see the page list or the page arrows. Turn off if you add multi-page eyes later. Personal journals always show their list.

folderName.name: Personal journals folder
folderName.hint: The folder every player's personal journal is kept in. Hidden; set it from the console. Empty uses the default name.
